gui.pvzce.jev.commander.hint: Optional: with a key here, a chat model reads the board every 30 seconds and writes the next minute's plan into Jev's prompt (visible in F3).
gui.pvzce.jev.commander.takeover: Commander plays the move itself when a zombie is close: %s
gui.pvzce.jev.hint: Leave the key empty to play the built-in opponent. Fill it in and save to let Jev command the other side.
gui.pvzce.jev.note: The key is kept in this machine's config/pvzce-client.toml; it is never written into a save or a log.
gui.pvzce.jev.paste: Click a field and press Ctrl+V to paste.
gui.pvzce.versus.no_goal: No sun goal in this level: hold the lawn
gui.pvzce.versus.opponent.fallback: Opponent: built-in policy (Jev did not answer)
gui.pvzce.versus.zombie_zone: That cell is outside your placement zone: zombies go in the four right columns.
level_buff.pvzce.auto_collect.desc: Sun and coins fly into the bank on their own
level_buff.pvzce.fog_retreat.desc: The fog starts further right, so more of the lawn is visible
level_buff.pvzce.sun_shovel.desc: Digging a plant up returns some of its sun
level_buff.pvzce.kelp_spread.desc: Kelp creeps across the water next to it
plant.pvzce.bowling_nut.desc: Bowling Wall-nuts are rolled down the lane to knock zombies over.
plant.pvzce.bowling_nut.flavor: Bowling Wall-nut never asked to be a projectile. He was a perfectly good Wall-nut, minding his own business, until someone decided he would look better in a bowling shirt.
plant.pvzce.cabbage_pult.desc: Cabbage-pults hurl cabbages at the enemy.
plant.pvzce.cabbage_pult.flavor: Cabbage-pult is okay with launching cabbages at zombies. It's what he's paid for, after all, and he's good at it. He just doesn't understand how the zombies get up on the roof in the first place.
plant.pvzce.cactus.desc: Cactuses shoot spikes that can hit both ground and air targets.
plant.pvzce.cactus.flavor: She's prickly, sure, but Cactus' spikes belie a spongy heart filled with love and goodwill. She just wants to hug and be hugged. Most folks can't hang with that, but Cactus doesn't mind. She's been seeing an armadillo for a while and it really seems to be working out.
plant.pvzce.cherry_bomb.desc: Cherry Bombs can blow up all zombies in an area. They have a short fuse so plant them near zombies.
plant.pvzce.cherry_bomb.flavor: "I wanna explode," says Cherry #1. "No, let's detonate instead!" says his brother, Cherry #2. After intense consultation they agree to explodonate.
plant.pvzce.chomper.desc: Chompers can devour a zombie whole, but they are vulnerable while chewing.
plant.pvzce.chomper.flavor: Chomper almost got a gig doing stunts for The Little Shop of Horrors but it fell through when his agent demanded too much on the front end. Chomper's not resentful, though. He says it's just part of the business.
plant.pvzce.cob_cannon.desc: Planted on two side-by-side Kernel-pults. Once loaded, click the cannon and then a cell: a cob lands there and levels a 3x3 area.
plant.pvzce.cob_cannon.flavor: It does not care to be called an upgraded Kernel-pult. It is a cannon. A cannon and a pult are two different things.
plant.pvzce.gold_magnet.desc: The Magnet-shroom's upgrade, re-aimed at money: coins in reach fly into the wallet on their own, so the lawn does not have to be swept click by click.
plant.pvzce.gold_magnet.flavor: It tried iron, then keys, then fridge magnets. Money, it concluded, is the only one that really pays.
plant.pvzce.coffee_bean.desc: Use Coffee Beans to wake up sleeping mushrooms.
plant.pvzce.coffee_bean.flavor: "Hey, guys, hey!" says Coffee Bean. "Hey! What's up? Who's that? Hey! Didja see that thing? What thing? Whoa! Lions!" Yep, Coffee Bean sure does get excited.
plant.pvzce.doom_shroom.desc: Doom-shrooms destroy everything in a large area and leave a crater that can't be planted on.
plant.pvzce.doom_shroom.flavor: "You're lucky I'm on your side," says Doom-shroom. "I could destroy everything you hold dear. It wouldn't be hard."
plant.pvzce.flower_pot.desc: Flower Pots let you plant on the roof.
plant.pvzce.flower_pot.flavor: "I'm a pot for planting. Yet I'm also a plant. HAS YOUR MIND EXPLODED YET?"
plant.pvzce.fume_shroom.desc: Fume-shrooms shoot fumes that can pass through screen doors.
plant.pvzce.fume_shroom.flavor: "I was in a dead-end job producing yeast spores for a bakery," says Fume-shroom. "Then Puff-shroom, bless 'im, told me about this great opportunity blasting zombies. Now I really feel like I'm making a difference."
plant.pvzce.gatling_pea.desc: Gatling Peas shoot four peas at a time.
plant.pvzce.gatling_pea.flavor: Gatling Pea's parents were concerned when he announced his intention to join the military. "But honey, it's so dangerous!" they said in unison. Gatling Pea refused to budge. "Life is dangerous," he replied, eyes glinting with steely conviction.
plant.pvzce.grave_buster.desc: Plant Grave Busters on graves to remove the graves.
plant.pvzce.grave_buster.flavor: Despite Grave Buster's fearsome appearance, he wants everyone to know that he loves kittens and spends his off hours volunteering at a local zombie rehabilitation center. "It's just the right thing to do," he says.
plant.pvzce.hypno_shroom.desc: When eaten, Hypno-shrooms will make a zombie turn around and fight for you.
plant.pvzce.hypno_shroom.flavor: "Zombies are our friends," asserts Hypno-shroom. "They're badly misunderstood creatures who play a valuable role in our ecology. We can and should do more to bring them round to our way of thinking."
plant.pvzce.ice_shroom.desc: Ice-shrooms temporarily immobilize all zombies on the screen.
plant.pvzce.ice_shroom.flavor: Ice-shroom frowns, not because he's unhappy or because he disapproves, but because of a childhood injury that left his facial nerves paralyzed.
plant.pvzce.jalapeno.desc: Jalapenos destroy an entire lane of zombies.
plant.pvzce.jalapeno.flavor: "NNNNNGGGGG!!!!!!!!" Jalapeno says. He's not going to explode, not this time. But soon. Oh, so soon. It's close. He knows it, he can feel it, his whole life's been leading up to this moment.
plant.pvzce.kernel_pult.desc: Kernel-pults fling corn kernels and butter at zombies.
plant.pvzce.kernel_pult.flavor: Kernel-pult is the eldest of the Pult brothers. Of the three of them, Kernel is the only one who consistently remembers the others' birthdays. He bugs them about it a little, too.
plant.pvzce.lily_pad.desc: Lily pads let you plant non-aquatic plants on top of them.
plant.pvzce.lily_pad.flavor: Lily Pad never complains. Lily Pad never wants to know what's going on. Put a plant on top of Lily Pad, he won't say a thing. Does he have startling opinions or shocking secrets? Nobody knows. Lily Pad keeps it all inside.
plant.pvzce.marigold.desc: Marigolds give you silver and gold coins.
plant.pvzce.marigold.flavor: Marigold spends a lot of time deciding whether to spit out a silver coin or a gold one. She thinks about it, weighs the angles. She does solid research and keeps up with current publications. That's how winners stay ahead.
plant.pvzce.melon_pult.desc: Melon-pults do heavy damage to groups of zombies.
plant.pvzce.melon_pult.flavor: There's no false modesty with Melon-pult. "Sun-for-damage, I deliver the biggest punch on the lawn," he says. "I'm not bragging. Run the numbers. You'll see."
plant.pvzce.pea_shooter.desc: Peashooters are your first line of defense. They shoot peas at attacking zombies.
plant.pvzce.pea_shooter.flavor: How can a single plant grow and shoot so many peas so quickly? Peashooter says, "Hard work, commitment, and a healthy, well-balanced breakfast of sunlight and high-fiber carbon dioxide make it all possible."
plant.pvzce.potato_mine.desc: Potato Mines pack a powerful punch, but they need a while to arm themselves. You should plant them ahead of zombies. They will explode on contact.
plant.pvzce.potato_mine.flavor: Some folks say Potato Mine is lazy, that he leaves everything to the last minute. Potato Mine says nothing. He's too busy thinking about his investment strategy.
plant.pvzce.puff_shroom.desc: Puff-shrooms are cheap, but can only fire a short distance.
plant.pvzce.puff_shroom.flavor: "I only recently became aware of the existence of zombies," says Puff-shroom. "Like many fungi, I'd just assumed they were fairy tales or movie monsters. This whole experience has been a huge eye-opener for me."
plant.pvzce.repeater.desc: Repeaters fire two peas at a time.
plant.pvzce.repeater.flavor: Repeater is fierce. He's from the streets. He doesn't take attitude from anybody, plant or zombie, and he shoots peas to keep people at a distance. Secretly, though, Repeater yearns for love.
plant.pvzce.scaredy_shroom.desc: Scaredy-shrooms are long-ranged shooters that hide when enemies get near them.
plant.pvzce.scaredy_shroom.flavor: "Who's there?" whispers Scaredy-shroom, voice barely audible. "Go away. I don't want to see anybody. Unless it's the man from the circus."
plant.pvzce.snow_pea.desc: Snow Peas shoot frozen peas that damage and slow the enemy.
plant.pvzce.snow_pea.flavor: Folks often tell Snow Pea how "cool" he is, or exhort him to "chill out." They tell him to "stay frosty." Snow Pea just rolls his eyes. He's heard 'em all.
plant.pvzce.split_pea.desc: Its front head fires one pea; its rear head fires two. Each watches its own side.
plant.pvzce.split_pea.flavor: Yeah, I'm a Gemini," says Split Pea. "I know, big surprise. But having two heads -- or really, one head with a large head-like growth on the back -- pays off big in my line of work."
plant.pvzce.squash.desc: Squashes will smash the first zombie that gets close to it.
plant.pvzce.squash.flavor: "I'm ready!" yells Squash. "Let's do it! Put me in! There's nobody better! I'm your guy! C'mon! Whaddya waiting for? I need this!"
plant.pvzce.sun_shroom.desc: Sun-shrooms give small sun at first and normal sun later.
plant.pvzce.sun_shroom.flavor: Sun-shroom hates sun. He hates it so much that when it builds up in his system, he spits it out as fast as he can. He just won't abide it. To him, sun is crass.
plant.pvzce.sunflower.desc: Sunflowers are essential for you to produce extra sun. Try planting as many as you can!
plant.pvzce.sunflower.flavor: Sunflower can't resist bouncing to the beat. Which beat is that? Why, the life-giving jazzy rhythm of the Earth itself, thumping at a frequency only Sunflower can hear.
plant.pvzce.tangle_kelp.desc: Tangle Kelp are aquatic plants that pull the first zombie that nears them underwater.
plant.pvzce.tangle_kelp.flavor: "I'm totally invisible," Tangle Kelp thinks to himself. "I'll hide here just below the surface and nobody will see me." His friends tell him they can see him perfectly well, but he'll never change.
plant.pvzce.threepeater.desc: Threepeaters shoot peas in three lanes.
plant.pvzce.threepeater.flavor: Threepeater likes reading, backgammon and long periods of immobility in the park. Threepeater enjoys going to shows, particularly modern jazz. "I'm just looking for that special someone," he says. Threepeater's favorite number is 5.
plant.pvzce.wall_nut.desc: Wall-nuts have hard shells which you can use to protect your other plants.
plant.pvzce.wall_nut.flavor: "People wonder how I feel about getting constantly chewed on by zombies," says Wall-nut. "What they don't realize is that with my limited senses all I can feel is a kind of tingling, like a relaxing back rub."
plant.pvzce.winter_melon.desc: Winter Melons do heavy damage and slow groups of zombies.
plant.pvzce.winter_melon.flavor: Winter Melon tries to calm his nerves. He hears zombies approach. Will he make it? Will anyone make it?

resource.pvzce.coin_gold.desc: A gold coin, worth five times as much as a silver one.
resource.pvzce.coin_gold.flavor: Gold coins are rarer, shinier and worth exactly five silver coins. That is the whole story.
resource.pvzce.coin_silver.desc: A silver coin, dropped by a defeated zombie or dug up by a Grave Buster.
resource.pvzce.coin_silver.flavor: Silver coins are the small change of the undead economy. Nobody knows what a zombie would spend them on.
resource.pvzce.diamond.desc: A diamond, dropped by a Zombie Yeti that was killed before it could run away.
resource.pvzce.diamond.flavor: Little is known about the Zombie Yeti other than his name, birth date, social security number, educational history, past work experience, and sandwich preference (roast beef and Swiss).
resource.pvzce.energy_bean.desc: An energy bean, the resource a plant spends to unleash its special ability.
resource.pvzce.energy_bean.flavor: Nobody has ever seen an energy bean grow. They are found, not farmed, which is exactly what a zombie would say about brains.
resource.pvzce.money_bag.desc: A money bag, dropped by a Gargantuar. Worth a great deal of coins at once.
resource.pvzce.money_bag.flavor: The bag is not actually full of money. It is full of brains. The coins are a courtesy.
resource.pvzce.redstone.desc: Redstone, the resource the machinery of the yard runs on.
resource.pvzce.redstone.flavor: Redstone is not of this garden. It was here before the lawn, before the house, and possibly before the zombies, which is saying something.
resource.pvzce.sun.desc: Sun is the resource every plant is paid for with. Click a falling sun to collect it.
resource.pvzce.sun.flavor: Sunlight is the stuff of life. It is also the stuff of planting, which is the same thing with more zombies in it.
tool.pvzce.water_bucket.desc: Fill an empty flower pot for aquatic plants. Free, 10-second recharge. Water stays permanently; land plants need a Lily Pad.
zombie.pvzce.backup_dancer.desc: These zombies appear in groups of four whenever Dancing Zombie rocks out. If they die he will summon replacements.
zombie.pvzce.backup_dancer.flavor: Backup Dancer Zombie spent six years perfecting his art at the Chewliard Performing Arts School in Zombie New York City.
zombie.pvzce.balloon_zombie.desc: This zombie uses a balloon tied around his waist to fly over most plants.
zombie.pvzce.balloon_zombie.flavor: Balloon Zombie really lucked out. The balloon thing really works and none of the other zombies have picked up on it.
zombie.pvzce.basic_zombie.desc: This zombie is your standard garden-variety zombie. He has no defensive equipment or special abilities to protect himself with and is susceptible to any attack.
zombie.pvzce.basic_zombie.flavor: This zombie loves brains. Can't get enough. Brains, brains, brains, day in and night out. Old and stinky brains? Rotten brains? Brains clearly past their prime? Doesn't matter. Regular zombie wants 'em.
zombie.pvzce.buckethead_zombie.desc: This zombie is protected by the metal bucket he wears on his head, which makes him very resistant to damage. He has around five times the health of a standard zombie.
zombie.pvzce.buckethead_zombie.flavor: Buckethead Zombie always wore a bucket. Part of it was to assert his uniqueness in an uncaring world. Mostly he just forgot it was there in the first place.
zombie.pvzce.conehead_zombie.desc: This zombie wears an orange traffic cone on his head as protection. He has around 2.5 times as much health as a standard zombie.
zombie.pvzce.conehead_zombie.flavor: Conehead Zombie shuffled mindlessly forward like every other zombie. But something made him stop, made him pick up a traffic cone and stick it on his head. Oh yeah. He likes to party.
zombie.pvzce.dancing_zombie.desc: This zombie enters the lawn by moonwalking onto it and will summon four Backup Dancers above, below, in front of and behind him before dancing towards the player's house.
zombie.pvzce.dancing_zombie.flavor: Dancing Zombie's latest album, "GrarrBRAINSarblarbl," is already rocketing up the undead charts.
zombie.pvzce.dolphin_rider_zombie.desc: This zombie is essentially an aquatic version of Pole Vaulting Zombie, using a dolphin to vault over the first plant he encounters. The main difference is that he is much faster before vaulting.
zombie.pvzce.dolphin_rider_zombie.flavor: The dolphin is also a zombie.
zombie.pvzce.door_zombie.desc: This zombie carries a screen door in front of him that acts as a shield.
zombie.pvzce.door_zombie.flavor: He got his screen door from the last inexpertly defended home he visited, after he ATE THE HOMEOWNER'S BRAINS.
zombie.pvzce.ducky_tube_buckethead_zombi: A Ducky Tube Zombie protected by the metal bucket he wears on his head.
It takes a certain kind of zombie to be a Ducky Tuber. Not every zombie can handle it. Some crack. They can't take it. They walk away and give up on brains forever.
A Ducky Tube Zombie wearing an orange traffic cone on his head as protection.
It takes a certain kind of zombie to be a Ducky Tuber. Not every zombie can handle it. Some crack. They can't take it. They walk away and give up on brains forever.
zombie.pvzce.ducky_tube_zombie.desc: This zombie wears an inflatable ducky tube that allows him to float on water in the pool. He also appears from underwater during the final waves of pool and fog levels.
zombie.pvzce.ducky_tube_zombie.flavor: It takes a certain kind of zombie to be a Ducky Tuber. Not every zombie can handle it. Some crack. They can't take it. They walk away and give up on brains forever.
zombie.pvzce.flag_zombie.desc: This zombie carries a red flag with a brain on it. He heralds the arrival of a large wave of zombies, of which every standard Adventure Mode level has at least one.
zombie.pvzce.flag_zombie.flavor: Make no mistake, Flag Zombie loves brains. But somewhere down the line he also picked up a fascination with flags. Maybe it's because the flags always have brains on them. Hard to say.
zombie.pvzce.football_zombie.desc: This zombie wears the outfit of an American football player. He is quite the dangerous zombie as he is fast and his helmet makes him extremely resistant to damage.
zombie.pvzce.football_zombie.flavor: Football Zombie gives 110 percent whenever he's on the field. He's a team player who delivers both offensively and defensively. He has no idea what a football is.
zombie.pvzce.gargantuar.desc: Gargantuar is a gigantic zombie that boasts the highest health of all standard zombies. He carries a weapon that he uses to crush plants instead of eating them, and he throws the Imp on his back once he has lost half of his health.
zombie.pvzce.gargantuar.flavor: When Gargantuar walks, the Earth trembles. When he moans, other zombies fall silent. He is the zombie other zombies dream they could be. But he still can't find a girlfriend.
zombie.pvzce.imp.desc: Imp is a small zombie who is hurled by Gargantuar deep into your defenses. After landing he will proceed on foot. He is faster than standard zombies.
zombie.pvzce.imp.flavor: Imp may be small, but he's wiry. He's proficient in zombie judo, zombie karate, and zombie bare-knuckle brawling. He also plays the melodica.
zombie.pvzce.miner_zombie.desc: This zombie uses a pickaxe to dig under your lawn. He will emerge on the left side, wait five seconds, then begin eating your plants, walking left to right.
zombie.pvzce.miner_zombie.flavor: Digger Zombie spends three days a week getting his excavation permits in order.
zombie.pvzce.mini_basic_zombie.flavor: This zombie loves brains. Can't get enough. Brains, brains, brains, day in and night out. Old and stinky brains? Rotten brains? Brains clearly past their prime? Doesn't matter. Regular zombie wants 'em.
zombie.pvzce.mini_conehead_zombie.flavor: Conehead Zombie shuffled mindlessly forward like every other zombie. But something made him stop, made him pick up a traffic cone and stick it on his head. Oh yeah. He likes to party.
zombie.pvzce.mini_ducky_tube_zombie.flav: It takes a certain kind of zombie to be a Ducky Tuber. Not every zombie can handle it. Some crack. They can't take it. They walk away and give up on brains forever.
zombie.pvzce.mini_ducky_tube_conehead_zo: A miniature Ducky Tube Conehead Zombie: the pool has little coneheads too.
It put that tiny cone on itself. Nobody told it there is nothing to bump into in the pool.
zombie.pvzce.mini_flag_zombie.flavor: Make no mistake, Flag Zombie loves brains. But somewhere down the line he also picked up a fascination with flags. Maybe it's because the flags always have brains on them. Hard to say.
zombie.pvzce.mini_football_zombie.flavor: Football Zombie gives 110 percent whenever he's on the field. He's a team player who delivers both offensively and defensively. He has no idea what a football is.
zombie.pvzce.mini_snorkel_zombie.flavor: Zombies don't breathe. They don't need air. So why does Snorkel Zombie need a snorkel to swim underwater? Answer: peer pressure.
zombie.pvzce.newspaper_zombie.desc: This zombie carries a newspaper that acts as a shield, absorbing 150 damage. When it is destroyed he will get angry and receive a boost to his speed, both when walking and eating plants.
zombie.pvzce.newspaper_zombie.flavor: Newspaper Zombie was *this* close to finishing his Sudoku puzzle. No wonder he's freaking out.
zombie.pvzce.pole_vaulter_zombie.desc: When Pole Vaulting Zombie enters the lawn he will jog briskly carrying a vaulting pole. As soon as he reaches a plant he will use the pole to leap over it. After that he loses the pole and his speed slows to that of a regular zombie.
zombie.pvzce.pole_vaulter_zombie.flavor: Some zombies take it further, aspire more, push themselves beyond the normal into greatness. That's Pole Vaulting Zombie right there. That is so him.
zombie.pvzce.snorkel_zombie.desc: Snorkel Zombie only appears in the pool, and submerges himself in water while moving, allowing him to evade most attacks except for lobbed-shot plants. However if there is a plant in his way he will have to surface to eat it, rendering him vulnerable.
zombie.pvzce.snorkel_zombie.flavor: Zombies don't breathe. They don't need air. So why does Snorkel Zombie need a snorkel to swim underwater? Answer: peer pressure.
zombie.pvzce.zombie_boss.desc: Dr. Zomboss is the intelligent leader of the zombies and the final boss of the game. He battles the player inside his fearsome Zombot.
zombie.pvzce.zombie_boss.flavor: Edgar George Zomboss achieved his Doctorate in Thanatology in only two years. Quickly mastering thanatological technology, he built his fearsome Zombot and set about establishing absolute dominance of his local subdivision.

plant.pvzce.spikeweed.desc: Zombies walk over it and are hurt the whole way.
plant.pvzce.torchwood.desc: Peas that fly through it burn for double damage.
plant.pvzce.tall_nut.desc: Taller and tougher than a wall-nut; pole vaulters cannot clear it.
plant.pvzce.sea_shroom.desc: A free shooter that only grows in water, and sleeps by day.
plant.pvzce.plantern.desc: Lights a circle of the fog so you can see what is in it.
plant.pvzce.blover.desc: One gust blows every flying zombie off the lawn.
plant.pvzce.starfruit.desc: Shoots stars left, up, down and diagonally forward.
plant.pvzce.pumpkin.desc: Shells the plant in its cell and takes the bites for it.
plant.pvzce.magnet_shroom.desc: Takes nearby metal equipment, then recharges. Sleeps in daylight.
plant.pvzce.spikeweed.flavor: "It hurts to walk on." - a zombie, walking on it
plant.pvzce.torchwood.flavor: A burnt stump that never went out. Peas go in, fire peas come out.
plant.pvzce.tall_nut.flavor: A wall-nut's cousin. Pole vaulters put the pole away when they see it.
plant.pvzce.sea_shroom.flavor: A mushroom that grows in water, costs nothing, and is sleepy by day.
plant.pvzce.plantern.flavor: The first lamp in the fog. With it, you find out what those shapes are.
plant.pvzce.blover.flavor: One gust and the sky is clear.
plant.pvzce.starfruit.flavor: The five points are not decoration: it really does shoot all five ways.
plant.pvzce.pumpkin.flavor: Hollow, so it fits over a plant. It takes the bites so you can keep shooting.
plant.pvzce.magnet_shroom.flavor: Buckets, doors, football helmets - it only cares about metal.
zombie.pvzce.bungee_zombie.desc: Descends to steal plants or deliver enemies. Vulnerable while at the bottom.
zombie.pvzce.bungee_zombie.flavor: It does not bite. It just takes things.
zombie.pvzce.zamboni_zombie.desc: Drives across the lawn, crushing what is in its way and leaving ice nothing can be planted in.
zombie.pvzce.zamboni_zombie.flavor: The machine is a lot harder to deal with than the zombie driving it.
zombie.pvzce.bobsled_zombie.desc: Four zombies on one sled. They only ride on ice, and the sled's 300 health is what is holding the team together.
zombie.pvzce.bobsled_zombie.flavor: They only run where the zamboni has already been.
zombie.pvzce.jack_in_the_box_zombie.desc: Limps in winding its box. When the lid comes up it destroys every plant near it, and the zombies too.
zombie.pvzce.jack_in_the_box_zombie.flav: The tune is the warning. There is no second verse.
zombie.pvzce.pogo_zombie.desc: Bounces over your plants without ever stopping to eat. Only a tall-nut can break the stick.
zombie.pvzce.zombotany_pea_zombie.desc: Wears a peashooter and shoots back at your plants.
zombie.pvzce.zombotany_pea_zombie.flavor: It probably thinks this is fair.
zombie.pvzce.zombotany_gatling_zombie.de: Its head fires four peas at a time; the worst of the bunch.
zombie.pvzce.zombotany_gatling_zombie.fl: Four times the firepower, same brain.
zombie.pvzce.zombotany_wallnut_zombie.de: The nut on its head is tougher than a bucket; chew through it first.
zombie.pvzce.zombotany_wallnut_zombie.fl: It does not seem bothered by it.
zombie.pvzce.zombotany_jalapeno_zombie.d: Explodes when it falls, taking half the health of the plants beside it.
zombie.pvzce.zombotany_jalapeno_zombie.f: The best time to deal with it is while it is still far away.
tool.pvzce.vase.desc: Free, ten-second recharge. Place it on the lawn; click it with a plant card to store the card, or with nothing in hand to smash it.

plant.pvzce.twin_sunflower.desc: The Sunflower's upgrade: two units of sun per glow instead of one.
plant.pvzce.twin_sunflower.flavor: "Two heads, two suns, twice the fun." - Twin Sunflower
plant.pvzce.gloom_shroom.desc: The Fume-shroom's upgrade: it bursts spores in every direction, hitting everything around it.
plant.pvzce.gloom_shroom.flavor: The Gloom-shroom does not say much. It prefers to express itself with spores.
plant.pvzce.spikerock.desc: The Spikeweed's upgrade: it stabs twice as hard and survives several vehicles.
plant.pvzce.spikerock.flavor: Every scratch on a Spikerock is a car that did not make it.
plant.pvzce.cattail.desc: The Lily Pad's upgrade: it hurls homing spikes at the nearest zombie anywhere on the lawn.
plant.pvzce.cattail.flavor: The Cattail has poor eyesight, so it trusts its instincts. Its instincts are excellent.
pvzce.preparation.hint: Preparation: initial sun only - build, then start
pvzce.mechanic.preparation.field.manual: Started by hand (off = the duration below starts it)
pvzce.mechanic.preparation.field.ticks: Preparation length in ticks (only used when not manual)
plant.pvzce.giant_nut.desc: The bowling Wall-nut, enlarged: it flattens everything in its lane and never stops.
plant.pvzce.giant_nut.flavor: "There are no second chances on the lane."
plant.pvzce.explosive_nut.desc: The bowling Wall-nut with a blast: the first zombie it touches sets it off.
plant.pvzce.explosive_nut.flavor: "There are no second chances on the lane."
plant.pvzce.iceboom_shroom.desc: Every bolt chills a zombie a little deeper, and the third one freezes it solid. A bolt that lands on a frozen zombie shatters it for triple damage.
plant.pvzce.iceboom_shroom.flavor: "Don't be in a hurry to thaw," says the Ice-boom Shroom. "Let it stand still first, then let it break."
plant.pvzce.echo_lily.desc: 125 sun. Alone: 40 damage every 3s. Orthogonally linked lilies relay one 60-damage wave each, including paths through Resonance Moss. Three relay volleys charge 6s of resonance: 1 lily gives 1.5x, each extra lily adds 0.25, capped at 3x, using the current network. A resonance row excites the network directly. Gold links, charge lights and rate labels show its state. Diagonals never connect.
plant.pvzce.echo_lily.flavor: A song too long for one flower is passed to the next.
pvzce.mechanic.resonance.desc: A travelling row speeds zombies up and excites any lily or moss network it intersects; haste scales with lily count.
plant.pvzce.resonance_moss.desc: 75 sun. A land carrier: plants on top join the lily network. Adjacent moss extends its connections. Resonance speeds up attacks and sun production: 1 lily gives 1.5x, each extra lily adds 0.25, capped at 3x. Moss adds no strength. Place moss before its upper plant; cannot share the carrier layer with a pot or lily pad. No connected lily means no haste.
plant.pvzce.resonance_moss.flavor: Step up. Your beat belongs in this choir too.
level_buff.pvzce.butter_plenty.desc: Kernel-pults have a 40% chance to lob butter
plant.pvzce.garlic.desc: Redirects biting walkers into an adjacent lane.
plant.pvzce.umbrella_leaf.desc: Protects the surrounding nine cells from basketballs and bungees.
zombie.pvzce.ladder.desc: Places a ladder on nuts and pumpkins for walkers to cross.
zombie.pvzce.catapult.desc: Lobs basketballs at the back row, then drives forward when empty.
tool.pvzce.fertilizer.desc: One plant attacks and produces sun at 2x speed for 30 seconds. Free; 45-second recharge. No healing; does not multiply watering haste.
plant.pvzce.garlic.flavor: Garlic calls it a visit. His visitors call it a detour.
plant.pvzce.umbrella_leaf.flavor: She never trusts a forecast that says no basketballs.
zombie.pvzce.ladder.flavor: His ladder blocks peas, then builds a bridge for friends.
zombie.pvzce.catapult.flavor: He remembered the hoop drill and forgot extra basketballs.
